name: Marshall Islands

fees.name: Visitor Visa (V-1)
fees.validity: Typically up to 90 days stay; issued in advance via RMI Embassy / Division of Immigration
fees.applies: Nationalities not covered by visa exemption or visa-on-arrival (e.g. CHN, NGA, PAK, BGD)
fees.notes: Non-refundable application processing fee, per RMI Embassy Washington DC. Advance application required for nationals not on the exemption/VOA schedule.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (VOA) - fee waived
fees.applies: Nationals of ~80 countries with diplomatic relations / Pacific Islands Forum members (incl. Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, Japan, South Korea, Philippines, Russia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, Turkey, UAE)
fees.notes: RMI Division of Immigration schedule (as of March 2024) lists VOA fee as 'Waived'. Requires 6+ months passport validity and onward/return ticket. No extension, change of status, employment, study or research permitted.

fees.name: Business Visa (B-1)
fees.applies: Applicants with an approved Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL)

reciprocity_variations.note: Visa exempt under Compact of Free Association; no period restrictions, fee waived (also FSM and Palau).
UK listed with EU member countries on RMI exemption schedule: visa waiver 90 days in any 180, fee waived (ordinary passports).
On the VOA schedule: 90-day visa on arrival, fee waived.
Not on the exemption/VOA schedule; must apply in advance for Visitor Visa (V-1) with USD 100 processing fee.

free_visa_notes: Most visitors enter the Marshall Islands free of charge: US/FSM/Palau citizens are fully exempt (Compact of Free Association), EU + UK, Taiwan and Guatemala get a 90-day fee-waived visa waiver, and nationals of ~80 further countries get a fee-waived 90-day visa on arrival. Only nationalities outside these schedules pay the USD 100 V-1 visitor visa fee. A USD 20 departure fee applies to all travellers leaving RMI (embassy-published).
